Overview.Name: Swathi T
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Early_Morning (optional): Option 2: Plain curd (1 small bowl ~100 g)
Meal_1: Option 3: Rice rawa upma (1 bowl ~150 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Evening_Snack (optional): Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat with peanuts and onion (2 cups)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (100 g)
Option 3: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) & vegetable salad

Notes_and_Tips: Eat meals at consistent times daily to support a calm routine and stress reduction.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or chicken before eating rice.
Keep dinner slightly lighter than lunch.
Yoga days may slightly increase appetite, adding curd or an egg is acceptable.
